title: 집에서 요리하기: 재료, 조리법, 맛 표현
objective: By the end, you can use words for ingredients (재료, 양념), cooking (썰다, 볶다, 삶다, 익다), and taste (간, 싱겁다, 느끼하다, 고소하다) in short sentences about cooking a dish.
summary: Learn 10 intermediate words for ingredients, cooking methods, and taste that Koreans use when they cook at home.

task.title: Use cooking words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, fill in, or put in order the words that fit the situation.

words.meaning: ingredients (the things you need to make a dish)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to the supermarket to buy the ingredients for kimchi stew.

words.meaning: seasoning sauce, marinade (a mix of sauces and spices)
words.example: 고기에 양념을 해서 하루 동안 냉장고에 넣어 두세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Marinate the meat and keep it in the fridge for a day.

words.meaning: to slice, to cut (with a knife)
to stir-fry; to roast (seeds, beans) in a pan
words.exampleMeaning: Put some oil in the pan and stir-fry the vegetables first.

words.meaning: to boil (food in water until cooked)
words.exampleMeaning: After boiling the noodles, rinse them in cold water.

words.meaning: to be cooked (through), to be done
words.example: 감자가 다 익었는지 젓가락으로 찔러 보세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Poke the potato with a chopstick to see if it's cooked through.

words.meaning: how salty food is; 간을 보다 = to taste for salt, 간을 맞추다 = to season to taste
words.example: 간 좀 봐 줄래? 소금을 더 넣어야 할 것 같아.
words.exampleMeaning: Can you taste it for salt? I think it needs more.

words.example: 찌개가 좀 싱거워서 간장을 조금 더 넣었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The stew was a bit bland, so I added a little more soy sauce.

words.example: 이 크림 파스타는 좀 느끼해서 피클이랑 같이 먹어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This cream pasta is a bit rich, so I eat it with pickles.

words.meaning: nutty, savory (like sesame oil or roasted grains)
words.exampleMeaning: It tastes much nuttier with sesame oil in it.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 달걀을 껍질째 물에 넣고 10분 동안 (삶았어요 / 볶았어요). ② 남은 김치를 기름에 (삶아서 / 볶아서) 밥 위에 올렸어요.
Fill in the blank with 썰다 or 익다 in the right form: ① 당근은 작게 ____ 넣으세요. ② 닭고기가 아직 안 ____ 조금 더 끓여야 해요.
Fill in the blank with 싱겁다, 느끼하다, or 고소하다 in the -아요/어요 form: ① 삼겹살을 너무 많이 먹었더니 입이 ____. ② 볶은 깨를 뿌렸더니 냄새가 ____. ③ 소금을 깜빡하고 안 넣어서 국이 ____.

Fill in the blank with 재료, 양념, or 간. The particle is already written right after the blank, so write only the word: ① 떡, 어묵, 대파 같은 떡볶이 ____가 다 있는지 냉장고를 열어 봤어요. ② 불고기 ____은 간장, 설탕, 마늘을 섞어서 만들어요. ③ 불을 끄기 전에 ____을 한번 보세요.
Put the cooking steps in order: (가) 마지막에 간을 봐요. (나) 양파와 고기를 썰어요. (다) 고기가 다 익으면 양념을 넣어요. (라) 팬에 기름을 두르고 고기를 볶아요.
answers: ① 느끼해요 ② 고소해요 ③ 싱거워요
① 재료 ② 양념 ③ 간
